title: Postgraduate Programs
body:
M.A. (Master of Arts) - 2 Years

Our M.A. programs in Hindi, History, Political Science, and Geography are designed to foster advanced scholarship and deep analytical insight. These courses encourage students to engage in high-level research, critical theory, and academic discourse. Whether exploring historical narratives or contemporary geopolitical trends, our postgraduate scholars are prepared for careers in academia, policy-making, and specialized administrative roles.

M.Sc. (Master of Science) - 2 Years

The M.Sc. programs in Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Zoology, and Botany offer an intensive research-led environment. Students utilize our advanced laboratory facilities to conduct sophisticated experiments and quantitative analysis. This curriculum is tailored for those aiming for doctoral research, scientific consultancy, and leadership positions in the technical and environmental sectors, ensuring a mastery of complex scientific principles.
